description: ESP32-S3 Wi-Fi AT state-changing capture plan. It intentionally contains no network credentials and requires a separate read-only preflight record before a mutation can run.

cases.summary: Capture the response and observable state transition from STA mode to NULL mode without the optional auto-connect argument.
preconditions: The same physical board has first completed this case's --preflight capture.
Only run this case when preflight reports +WIFIMODE: 1 and no active station or SoftAP session needs credential-based recovery.
This plan must not contain an SSID or password.

operator_actions: Restore STA mode with the separately captured wifi_mode_write_sta case.
If preflight reported an active association or AP role, verify recovery manually; do not place credentials in this plan.

cases.summary: Capture the response and observable state transition restoring STA mode from the preceding NULL-mode case.
preconditions: The same physical board has first completed this case's --preflight capture.
Only run this case when preflight reports +WIFIMODE: 0 after a successful wifi_mode_write_null capture.
This plan must not contain an SSID or password.

operator_actions: This case restores the preceding wifi_mode_write_null preflight value of 1.
Verify +WIFIMODE: 1 after the write before attempting another state-changing case.

cases.summary: Capture the response to disabling automatic reconnect.
preconditions: The same physical board has first completed this case's --preflight capture.
Only run this case when preflight reports +RECONNECT: 1; otherwise it would not exercise a transition.

operator_actions: Restore the exact +RECONNECT value observed in preflight with a separately authorized write command.

cases.summary: Capture the response to enabling automatic reconnect and restore the preceding disable case's setting.
preconditions: The same physical board has first completed this case's --preflight capture.
Only run this recovery case when preflight reports +RECONNECT: 0.

operator_actions: This case restores the preceding reconnect_write_disable preflight value of 1.
Verify +RECONNECT: 1 after the write before attempting another state-changing case.

cases.summary: Capture the run-form disconnect response and post-disconnect status.
preconditions: The same physical board has first completed this case's --preflight capture.
This command may disconnect the active station and cannot be credential-free restored by the capture tool.

operator_actions: Do not assume that automatic reconnect will recover the association.
Reconnect only through a separately authorized, private credential procedure; never add that credential to this plan or its capture output.
